summary: Iteration 15 — Multi-language (zh-CN default / zh-TW / en) + 18-currency FX with daily refresh. Backend 13/13 pytest pass. Frontend: default zh-CN works (html.lang=zh-CN, header 登录/所有服务/快捷下单, ZH-CN/USD badge); English switch works (html.lang=en, Login/All services/Quick order, product names Douyin/MiGuo Live/bilibili Live Battery in English, Product Description/Reviews tabs, perks-slide-0='New users only / Daily limit 1 / Buy and get unlimited gifts'); zh-TW switch works (登入 / 所有服務, no simplified leakage); localStorage gt_lang persists. Price formatting on product page verified: USD $8.69 (2 dec), KRW ₩11,590 (0 dec), CNY ¥65.18 (2 dec). Search works both EN ('douyin' → Douyin results) and zh-CN ('抖音' → 抖音 results). Backend: GET /api/currencies returns 18 sorted USD-first with rate_to_usd; GET /api/categories localizes correctly (en has English names, zh-CN has 游戏/no 遊戲, default traditional has 遊戲/平臺); GET /api/i18n/stats returns {cached, pending}; POST /api/cron/refresh-rates rejects wrong/missing bearer with 401, accepts valid secret with {ok:true}, idempotent on same X-Webhook-Id (duplicate:true), rate_updated_at populated after refresh; GET/PUT /api/admin/currencies works with admin JWT; manual CNY override (rate 7.5, auto_rate=false) is preserved through POST /api/admin/currencies/refresh while other auto currencies get updated rate_updated_at. Admin UI data-testids 'admin-refresh-rates' and 'admin-auto-rate-{code}' confirmed in Admin.jsx source.

minor.issue: USD document missing 'auto_rate' field (legacy seed via $setOnInsert didn't update existing docs). Server treats missing as auto=true via {auto_rate: {$ne: false}} so refresh works, but admin UI switch may render indeterminate for USD. Suggest a one-time seed migration to set auto_rate: true on all 18 currencies.

Caused by horizontal product rails where English card titles like 'bilibili Live Battery' or 'Meoo Live Top-up' are longer than zh-CN titles — the rail's parent appears to not clip overflow at the page level. zh-CN mode is clean. Visual layout still looks fine in screenshot (cards swipeable rail), but the whole page scrolls horizontally which is undesirable.

action_items: Fix horizontal overflow on mobile 375px in English: add overflow-x: hidden or proper container clipping to the horizontal product rails on home (zh-CN hidden overflow by shorter titles).
Optional: migrate USD (and any legacy currency doc) to have explicit auto_rate: true to avoid indeterminate admin switch rendering.
Optional: add '果豆→Fruit Beans' to GLOSSARY in /app/backend/translate.py for consistent spec-button English labels on MiGuo Live and similar products.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py refresh_rates (L1500): no exception handling if rates.get() returns non-numeric; relies on upstream open.er-api.com. Acceptable since try wraps the fetch but inner coercion errors would log and skip only that currency silently.

server.py cron_refresh_rates (L1368): correctly uses hmac.compare_digest for bearer and gates on X-Webhook-Id; however there is NO expiry on cron_runs documents — the collection will grow unbounded over time. Suggest TTL index.

translate.py Translator._worker: pending set is mutated during iteration via discard inside the loop; batches of 40 pulled per round. If translate_batch raises, items are already removed from pending (not re-queued). Suggest requeueing on failure or persisting pending in Mongo for durability across restarts.

i18n/index.js: dict lookup uses nullish-coalescing with zhCN fallback, which works, but setLang() hard-reloads the whole SPA — intentional per spec but causes a visible flash and resets scroll. Could be a future SPA-level state swap for better UX.

server.py get_products search (L278): builds translator.en reverse lookup in Python every request (O(n) over all cached translations). For 20k entries this is cheap but could be memoized via an inverse index on translator init.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all i18n flows + price formatting pass; one minor mobile overflow in EN mode)

rca of the issue: Mobile EN overflow RCA: the horizontal product rails use `shrink-0` flex items with explicit widths and the parent carousel likely has `overflow-x: auto` on itself but the parent section/body does not clip. In zh-CN, card titles truncate to 1 line within 92px because they are shorter CJK strings; in English, titles are mapped to longer latin strings and the truncate class works but the surrounding `A` tag/card width remains 106px with padding, so total offscreen rail content pushes the body width beyond viewport. Fix: ensure the horizontal rail wrapper has overflow-x:auto and a width:100% constraint, or wrap sections in `overflow-x: clip` on mobile.
